steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What was that broadcast about?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I-I don't know!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Did Kinbee use to be a TV host or something?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Kinbee?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Mifune.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: When I was little? I think I remember something like that.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I heard Mifune used to helm every program on the Kinseki Channel in its early days. News, variety shows, and sometimes he'd make a guest appearance on the weather channel too.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Come to think of it, I even helped them do a few of those long weather forecasts.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Later on when Kinseki Channel expanded, he only did breaking news, and as time went on, eventually disappeared off camera.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So, what he wants now is—

steps.name: Sharp-eyed Passerby
steps.text: Yo, that bike over there!

steps.name: Restless Passerby
steps.text: The Ao-Oni?!

steps.name: Restless Passerby
steps.text: She's really with Momoka!

steps.name: Restless Passerby
steps.text: So, should we stop them?

steps.name: Sharp-eyed Passerby
steps.text: You got a death wish?! Call the news!

steps.name: Sharp-eyed Passerby
steps.text: Just look her sobbing, I bet the Ao-Oni kidnapped her... maybe she's doing some mind control stuff too!

steps.name: Restless Passerby
steps.text: You call the news station, I'll get the cops.

steps.name: Sharp-eyed Passerby
steps.text: Didn't the cops issue a bunch of notices saying we shouldn't treat them like the Spiritual Affairs people and not to bother them for kaidan stuff?

steps.name: Restless Passerby
steps.text: Oh yeah.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Gah, we should speed up.
Momoka is going as fast as she can, but Hoshiguma still feels her vision only repeats some sort of gigantic loop.
Neon lights, pedestrians, skyscrapers, road crossings. Neon lights, pedestrians, skyscrapers, road crossings—
After some time, the loop finally breaks, and old neighborhoods like Kajimachi begin to show up in her view as the number of buildings grows sparse.
They eventually give way to large patches of wilderness bearing traces of construction work and outright abandoned plates.
The sky gradually brightens.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Hoshiguma-san, the place is right up ahead.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Alright—wait, you should slow down—we're gonna hit the gate at this rate!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Huh?!
Momoka hits the brake hard, but it is too late—
The scooter zooms into the shrine, only stopping right in the middle of the garden. Thanks to Momoka's excellent balance, the two are spared from being thrown off the vehicle.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Oh no, what if they think we're being rude...?

steps.name: Shrine Maiden Voice
steps.text: Kannushi-sama! A woman's fighting her way in again! She's on a bike this time!

steps.name: Shrine Priest's Voice
steps.text: Again?!

steps.name: Shrine Maiden Voice
steps.text: I don't know why, but no one's stopping her—them, I mean, and they're right in center courtyard!

steps.name: Unruffled Voice
steps.text: 'Them'?

steps.name: Unruffled Voice
steps.text: Check and see if it's a Vulpo, won't you?

steps.name: Shrine Maiden Voice
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Shrine Priest's Voice
steps.text: A Vulpo? No, it's an Ægir and an Oni.

steps.name: Shrine Maiden Voice
steps.text: They brought back terrible memories of last time, and I didn't look at them clearly in my panic, sorry...

steps.name: Unruffled Voice
steps.text: It's not your fault that concern wrecked your nerves.

steps.name: Unruffled Voice
steps.text: Whoever our guests may be, I'll simply entertain them. The rest of you, calm down and focus on your own work.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'm so sorry! I didn't mean to do this! I was just so nervous I forgot to use the brake—

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: I was wondering who it was. Are you not Momoka-san?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: K-Kannushi-sama...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Uh, you know each other?

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: Momoka-san used to be a regular visitor here. She last came five years ago, and I thought perhaps her wishes came true and that she was now living a happy life.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: No, not really... I just got so busy that I no longer had the time to visit.

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: No need to be sad. This is the Kizuna Jinja after all. You found success in your career, so I'm sure you formed lots of ties and connections with others.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: *Cries*...

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: May I know how to call Momoka's friend here?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm Hoshiguma. Looking for someone.

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: Whom, may I ask? The shrine is quite bereft of clergy.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No, I'm not looking for a priest. I came here to find a 'kami-sama' for somebody.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Specifically, I'm looking for a unicycle with an invisible rider. I guess people in Mitsukue call it 'Wanyuudou'. Is it really a kami?

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: If they were looking to establish some sort of connection or looking for a blessing, I'm afraid they should come here themselves. Prayers made on someone else's behalf will not work.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: He just wants to meet the kami. Didn't seem to care much about the forming ties or getting blessed type of thing.

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: Moriuchi-kun is truly a stubborn one... No, I should praise him for his tenacity.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You know him?

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: He's the one who insisted on meeting a specific kami with no want of blessing. We've become quite well-acquainted over the years.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: So this means you can help him find the kami, right?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Nah, Moriuchi asking us to do it for him means the priest failed.

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: It is as you say. We priests cannot do anything if the kami themselves are unwilling to appear.

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: Well, the two of you haven't technically disrespected the shrine, other than driving your scooter onto our grounds.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Wh-What should we do? Do I have to apologize to the kami-sama? How do I do that?

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: Let me think... To appease the kami's anger, please go over to the omamori stall there and buy a full set.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: Then go to the hundred-mon omikuji and draw fortunes until you get one each of 'sue-kichi', 'chu-kichi', 'dai-kichi'. It's alright if you draw any of the others—unless you get 'dai-kyou'—then you'll have to start over.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Eh?!

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: —Finally...

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: I'm just joking. The kami would never punish someone over a scooter.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Wha—?!

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: I pray the two of you will obtain what you truly desire here. Now, plenty of divine work awaits me, so I shall take my leave.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Phew! I was worried I wouldn't have enough mon for all that!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Seems like the kannushi isn't going to get in our way, so things are going pretty well for us.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Let's take it easy. Why not go over to the omikuji section for a break, while I look around the place?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Um... that works.
Hoshiguma slowly goes around the vacant shrine grounds.
She knows so little about shrines and Shinto she cannot even tell if it's a 'honden', 'haiden', or 'heiden' standing before her.
The only things resembling Moriuchi's keychain are the two statues behind the stone lanterns that were obviously based on Perro Beast Stewards.
But the breeze here is cool, and she cannot help but to recall her youth when she visited a monastery with her father.
Her father and Tessai's figures appear and disappear between the pine and cypress trees, and the abbot pats her head and she hears the tale of the first Oni.
That Oni's name seems to be... 'Qui'lon'...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Hoshiguma-san, Hoshiguma-san!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What's up?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: It's bad!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You got a 'dai-kyou'?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: No, a 'sue-kichi'—no, I didn't mean that! I mean, I heard something!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The Wanyuudou?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I don't know! Maybe, but what if... it's a ghost...?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: A ghost showing up this early in the morning might be some sort of super scary evil spirits, like onryo!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: We should trust the kannushi a little. You think he'd let evil spirits in here?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: True, but—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: There's that sound again!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Calm down.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Ugh, it's not like I could do that on command, even if I wanted to...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I didn't expect It'd actually show up here. There's tracks on the ground...
The unicycle seems to realize Its tracks are giving It away, and turns toward the stone pavement.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Wh-What do we do?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Isn't this better for us? Now It's locked onto the stone pavement.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: But... how is a kami unable to hide Its own tire tracks...?
What... do you mean... unable!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I-It spoke?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Behind the Beast Steward statue! Momoka, you're closer to It, over there!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I don't see It? Where did It go?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No, It circled around to your back—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: My... back?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Eek! A g-g-g-ghost's after me?!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Misfortune befalls anyone who sees the Wanyuudou, but It's actually chasing me—is my life over?!
Instantly, the girl and unicycle seem to change positions, the latter now hot on Momoka's heels, as if she was being chased by It from the very start.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Momoka, hold still!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: S-STILL?!
She does not grasp what is happening, but still subconsciously stops her steps.
Hoshiguma snatches the chance to hurl Hannya out, and the giant triangular shield blocks the unicycle's path, forcing It to brake.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Now keep holding position, Momoka! I'll catch It. Don't, and I mean it, don't panic if It runs toward you!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: O-O-Okay!
Hoshiguma closes in on the unicycle, blocking It from any easy escape routes.
It stops in Its tracks as the handlebars twist left and right—perhaps It does not know where to go, although it is no difficult decision.
On one side is a tall Oni, while on the other stands an Ægir It has just chased all over the place...
The pedals spin frantically, and the unicycle speeds straight for Momoka.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Momoka, grab It!
The unicycle dashes toward her, and Momoka's instinct screams at her to turn and run. But she keeps it a thought and does not move her legs.
Yabai. There's no other way, it's over, it's all over—such thoughts flood her mind as she stands there like a fowlbeast in headlights.

spans.text: There's no other way, it's over, it's all over—such thoughts flood her mind as she stands there like a fowlbeast in headlights.

steps.text: The unicycle approaches.
According to the kaidan tales, she is doomed—wait, that's not right. Wasn't she already down on her luck before running into the Wanyuudou?
Or maybe, if she hadn't run into Hoshiguma at the oden yatai, she would long since—
Momoka gulps, looks at Hoshiguma, then at the unicycle only a few steps away from her—
Instead of retreating, she jumps forward.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: Kannushi-sama, someone's disgraced the shrine by... jumping... into the pond...

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: Momoka? Hoshiguma too?

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: I don't know what's going on, but Ill help you two out! Forgive me, Kannushi-sama!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Hoshiguma? Kichisei?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: And...
One side of the pond lies a small unicycle leaning against a rock, pedals still moving on their own.
The thing on the unicycle appears before her, with a cycling helmet fitted perfectly on Its head. It's bright round eyes stare somewhat helplessly at all the water dripping to the floor.
Beside her, Hoshiguma's expression softens after making sure she's alright.
She nods in greeting to the person behind her, who Momoka guesses is Kichisei, then turns to look into the distance...
No matter what happened, it seems like she's finally accomplished something?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: So, in the end... It was a ghost after all?
Have you ever seen a ghost that could be struck by water, girl?
Besides, it was just a round of hide-and-seek. Why were you going at it so seriously?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: S-Seriously?
You looked like your life was on the line when you went into the pond with me.
Same goes for Moriuchi too. A kami I may be, but what makes him so sure a random god he finds on the streets is bound to be his maneki-neko?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Momoka, do you want me to lure the priest away? Or—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: No, it's alright. The person we're looking for—no, the 'kami' we're looking for is right here.

steps.name: Nosy Kami
steps.text: Relax, I'm already right before your eyes. No more running for me.

steps.name: Nosy Kami
steps.text: I'll watch over you, and no one on the shrine grounds will cause you any trouble. Soak in the pond for as long as you like.
Momoka carefully places a hand on the kami, and this time It no longer dodges her. Although It fidgets to her touch, but It seems to at least hold no objections to mortal contact.
The cool breeze drags slowly across the pond, as if all that running and chasing that happened before dawn was merely a strange and messy, but not terrifying dream.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Empty handed, are you?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: You couldn't even catch a girl scared out of her wits at the mere mention of a kaidan?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Silent, are you? We're all family here, we can laugh all this off, yes?

steps.name: Bold Yakuza
steps.text: That's not it, Oyabun!

steps.name: Bold Yakuza
steps.text: She was with that Ao-Oni, and we weren't strong enough...

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Weren't strong enough?
Mifune takes a fierce step forward, face nearly coming into contact with the bold yakuza.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Colluding with Tessai to obstruct Kajimachi's development, disobeying my orders, and fleeing without permission. Even, getting mixed up with that individual...

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Do you think you could get off just saying you weren't strong enough?

steps.name: Bold Yakuza
steps.text: Oyabun, I... I...

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Do you know what happened to Takehiko?

steps.name: Bold Yakuza
steps.text: Y-Yes. You were forced to kill him with your own hands, and afterwards organized a grand funeral for him, even weeping as you held a memorial at his grave...

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: And who truly killed him? Was it me?

steps.name: Bold Yakuza
steps.text: Of course it was that old bastard Tessai, he—

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: It was you! All of you! One by one, you proved your incompetence, allowing Tessai to get off scot-free, and that's how Takehiko died!
Mifune's hand slowly reaches inside his sleeve, as if to take something out.
The gangsters dare not move until their Oyabun pulls his fist back out into the open, slowly opening it...
Several heavy gold coins fall to the ground.

steps.name: Bold Yakuza
steps.text: Are those k-koban coins?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I found these in a drawer. Pick them up. They're yours now.

steps.name: Bold Yakuza
steps.text: Arigatou, Oyabun! But what for...?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: The next time you would tell me you're not strong enough, just cut off your own arm and use these to buy you a state-of-the-art prosthetic. Am I clear?

steps.name: Prudent Ninja
steps.text: Oyabun.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Speak.

steps.name: Prudent Ninja
steps.text: Our people went northward from Nita Street and located Momoka and Hoshiguma... inside the shrine.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Do you hear that? The ninja I personally cultivated are more capable than you lot. Learn from them, all of you.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: The shrine, eh?

steps.name: Prudent Ninja
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: A shrine. Sacred ground, unsullied land. No one will be happy if trouble occurs there.

steps.name: Prudent Ninja
steps.text: You mean...?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Take this useless bunch and surround the place. But be discreet—just make sure there is no way out.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: If they intend to hole up in there, send a few men in to force them outside. Don't let anyone they've had contact with off either. If you can't make a move near the shrine, do it elsewhere.

steps.name: Prudent Ninja
steps.text: Then the clergy inside...

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: The clergy? We can't touch them yet.

steps.name: Prudent Ninja
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Go. I have guests to see.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Mifune-san...
The frost on Mifune's face does not disappear at once, but it slowly melts when he sees Tetsuya, as if somewhat comforted by a hope for a new life after much toil and tumult.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: The guys who just left...

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Same slackers as always. You're the hardest worker I've got.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Enough about them. How was your visit home?

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: The Old Man... is the same as he ever was.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Don't feel bad.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I remember where you were only this tall, standing in-between your parents as they linked hands with you...

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: *Sighs* Who would have ever thought that your father would have no choice but to let go of that which was dearest to him, all for the Kinsekikai's sake...

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Mifune-san, there's no need to compliment my father. Being chairman for too long has robbed him of all human emotion.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: That can't be. The bond between parent and child is stronger than any other tie.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I used to treat your father as my own, in my younger days. Unfortunately the Old Man scorned me, and that's how our hostilities began.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: But this Northern Court spy incident may prove to be an opportunity.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: You mean...?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Your mother was wrongly accused because of her ambiguous relationship with an individual in the Northern Court. If you catch the spy, your father's attitude will surely improve.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: And it just so happens I have the latest intelligence in my hands.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Tell me, please! No matter where the spy is, I'll root him out!

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: This spy... is in Kajimachi, and is highly likely to be related to the so-called Haunted House.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: No way... Hoshiguma-san?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: She—no, she has nothing to do with this, only returned here by chance.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: But I can't get in there, if she stops me...

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Simply go in when she's away. Kajimachi is a big town after all, and finding any additional clues will be good. Go!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: A-At once!
Mifune's expression changes again when he sees a woman enter the room after Tetsuya leaves.
Tired, weary, impatient, and a sort of confidence mixed within. A sort of certainty that everything is under control and he merely has to wait for an opportunity to strike.
